description_ko: 다리 없이 하나의 굵은 분절형 태엽 몸통이 S자로 솟아오르고 바닥에 감기는 뱀형. 꽃 유리함과 한 쌍의 거대한 전지가위를 유지한다.

references.role: Original Flora Gear identity and material reference: dark teal gardener cap, ivory curls and porcelain mask, glass blue-flower chamber, apron panels and pruning-scissors family; no anatomy or pose lock
Previous Hard construction reference: opened calyx plates, connected back winding winch and curled teal spring strips; not the old body silhouette

visual_qa.method: Generated full image inspected; saved PNG decoded at full dimensions and source SHA verified. Browser-canvas JPEG review of the saved PNG inspected because view_image displayed the PNG as a thin lavender strip.
visual_qa.identity: Dark teal cap and short ivory curls, stern porcelain gardener face, exactly one blue flower and green stem in a brass-capped glass cylinder, ivory/navy-teal/brass palette, former apron leaf panels and a physically attached back winch with two curled spring strips retained.
visual_qa.transformation: No legs or feet. One continuous thick segmented lower body forms a weight-bearing ground coil, raised S-curve and one visible tapering tail tip. Leaf-shaped teal scale panels and brass mechanical spine integrate the enlarged upper calyx thorax with the serpent lower body.
visual_qa.mechanics: Exactly two articulated arms, one hand on each handle of one giant connected pruning scissors, shared round brass pivot and two blade tips plainly readable. One head and one flower chamber. No duplicate loose scissors or extra appendages.
visual_qa.framing: Cap, both curled spring tips, scissors tips, complete ground coil and single tail tip are inside frame. The upper spring tips have narrow but uncut margins. No text, inset, extra views or UI.
visual_qa.limits: Single-view 2D concept candidate. Not selected, not Tripo input turnaround, and not a validated 3D mesh or rig.
